snippet.title: Out Fishing - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Introducing Out Fishing, a first-person horror fishing simulator. Yes, you read that correctly. As the development team describes it, "During the day, it's a chill fishing sim. But as soon as night falls, it turns into psychological horror." It's in development for PC. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660260/Out_Fishing/
